item.title: Deion Sanders Brings Karrueche Tran to His Son Shedeur’s Browns Game
item.description: For Shedeur Sanders, the Cleveland Browns’ close defeat to the Buffalo Bills on Sunday was a family event. In addition, his father provided a plus one that attracted attention. In the 23-20 home loss to the Bills, Shedeur finished with 157 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions. The rookie quarterback from his father’s Colorado Buffaloes will be hurt by another defeat, but before the game, he had the opportunity to play in front of his family and have some memorable moments with his father.
